prompt:
Edit the input paint_mask_guide.png exactly as a precise-object-edit texture atlas. Inputs: image 1 paint_mask_guide.png is the EDIT TARGET and authoritative silhouette/layout; image 2 design_reference.png is material/detail reference; image 3 icon_x8.png is original colour reference, magenta is background only.
Output ONE transparent PNG, 1536x2048 (3:4). Preserve guide layout: 3 columns x FOUR rows of 512 square cells, same five orthographic views duplicated in upper/lower halves: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. Keep the actual guide orientations even if unusual. Every object must retain EXACT position, size, outline, gaps and openings. Paint grey pixels only, never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour of bronze-copper plate armour with red enamel trim, rounded layered bronze shoulder plates with dark rivets, breastplate of vertical bronze ribs edged in red, long skirt of horizontal bronze lames with red-edged side panels. Match approved design and original icon colours including pale metal panels. Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow design reference scaled to each view. No lighting, shadows, AO, hot highlights, reflections.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours ONLY, no shading, texture, outlines or antialiased colour blends inside. #FF0000 pure red for ALL metal (including bronze copper brass steel iron gold silver chain mail and rivets); #00FF00 pure green for leather/padding/hide/suede/fur; #0000FF pure blue for cloth/linings/cords/ribbons/hair; #000000 pure black for enamel/gems/crystal/glass/pearls/liquid. Red enamel trim is BLACK in mask; metal is RED. Every silhouette pixel gets exactly one colour, nothing outside silhouettes.
Preserve all gaps and openings fully transparent. Empty third-column cells in rows 2 and 4 fully transparent. No background, ground, text, labels, outlines, glow, sparkles or aura. This is a strict aligned paint/material-mask atlas, not a redesigned armour illustration.
CORRECTION: The prior attempt had scattered red pixels outside the lower silhouettes and changed openings. Start from the original guide again. Strictly preserve its alpha footprint in ALL cells; zero stray pixels, zero speckle or haze outside objects. Lower mask regions must be solid pure RGB colours with no shaded red edges, no linework. Keep guide openings as shown, do not invent holes. Exact guide silhouette alignment is the highest priority.
